verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's Vault entity explicitly lets platform engineers store secrets externally and reference them from other config entities so secrets 'aren't visible in plaintext throughout the platform,' directly matching the masked-secrets/external-vault-integration story. Missing for 10: no evidence of specific vault backend integrations (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) being named, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
